map_oop_small_band.teaches: Evaluate a two-operation expression with one set of parentheses when the arithmetic is light, so the item tests structure, not computation
map_oop_small_band.representation: One boxed B&W Andika cell (WORKSHEET_DESIGN_STANDARD.md), big digits, single grey for structure only; expression with the bracketed step marked and a working line under it; screen: number entry (production, not MC)
map_oop_small_band.why: paren_simple sampled products to 1,400; MAP grouping-symbol items use small numbers. This is a real option (new number band), not a re-grade

map_function_table_context.option: context: real-world table (headers such as Boxes / Pencils, Hours / Dollars) instead of In / Out
map_function_table_context.name: Function Tables in a Story
map_function_table_context.teaches: Find and write the rule of an input-output table whose columns are real quantities, then use it for a missing row
map_function_table_context.representation: One boxed B&W Andika cell (WORKSHEET_DESIGN_STANDARD.md), big digits, single grey for structure only; two-column table with word headers, rule frame "___ × ___" under it; screen: rule-frame entry (operation tile + number), never MC
map_function_table_context.why: DesCartes 211-220 "determines the rule given a simple real-world function table"; function_table_hard deals bare In/Out only

map_word_form_millions.option: band: to 999,999 and to millions (adds the thousands/millions period words), both directions via wordform
map_word_form_millions.name: Number Word Form to Millions
map_word_form_millions.teaches: Write the numeral for a number name to millions, and the name for a numeral, period by period
map_word_form_millions.representation: One boxed B&W Andika cell (WORKSHEET_DESIGN_STANDARD.md), big digits, single grey for structure only; number name over a digit-box row with comma separators between periods; screen: number entry (words → numeral) or word-bank entry (numeral → words)
map_word_form_millions.why: number_word_form is the live production skill but stops at 9,999; DesCartes 191-210 asks numeral/name over 100,000
